hook.en: The towering limestone hills around Ipoh and the caves of Gunung Mulu were shaped by rainwater over millions of years. Slow processes build spectacular landscapes.
hook.bm: Bukit batu kapur yang menjulang di sekitar Ipoh dan gua-gua di Gunung Mulu dibentuk oleh air hujan selama berjuta-juta tahun. Proses yang perlahan membina landskap yang menakjubkan.

bigIdeas.en: Weathering breaks rocks down in place; erosion wears them away and transports the material.
bigIdeas.bm: Luluhawa memecahkan batuan di tempatnya; hakisan menghakis dan mengangkut bahan tersebut.

bigIdeas.en: Rivers form V-shaped valleys and waterfalls upstream, meanders in the middle, and floodplains and deltas downstream.
bigIdeas.bm: Sungai membentuk lurah V dan air terjun di hulu, meander di bahagian tengah, serta dataran banjir dan delta di hilir.

bigIdeas.en: Waves erode headlands into caves, arches and stacks and deposit beaches and spits; rainwater dissolves limestone to make caves.
bigIdeas.bm: Ombak menghakis tanjung menjadi gua, gerbang laut dan batu tunggul, serta memendapkan pantai dan anak tanjung; air hujan melarutkan batu kapur membentuk gua.

definition.en: Breakdown of rocks in place by physical, chemical or biological action.
definition.bm: Pemecahan batuan di tempatnya oleh tindakan fizikal, kimia atau biologi.

definition.en: Wearing away and removal of rock and soil by water, wind or ice.
definition.bm: Penghakisan dan pemindahan batuan dan tanih oleh air, angin atau ais.

definition.en: Dropping of material when water or wind loses energy.
definition.bm: Pengendapan bahan apabila air atau angin kehilangan tenaga.

definition.en: Lake formed when a meander is cut off.
definition.bm: Tasik yang terbentuk apabila meander terputus.

definition.en: Limestone column hanging from a cave ceiling.
definition.bm: Tiang batu kapur yang tergantung dari bumbung gua.

question.en: Explain how an oxbow lake forms.

steps.en: Erosion on the outer bend and deposition on the inner bend make the meander loop tighter.
steps.bm: Hakisan di tebing luar dan pemendapan di tebing dalam menjadikan gelung meander semakin rapat.

steps.en: The neck of the loop narrows; during a flood the river cuts straight through.
steps.bm: Leher gelung semakin sempit; semasa banjir sungai memotong terus melaluinya.

steps.en: Deposition seals off the old loop, leaving an oxbow lake.
steps.bm: Pemendapan menutup gelung lama, meninggalkan tasik ladam.

answer.en: Meander → narrow neck → cut-through in flood → sealed loop = oxbow lake.
answer.bm: Meander → leher sempit → terpotong semasa banjir → gelung tertutup = tasik ladam.
